name: My Nephew's Husband and His Friends
source:
Your husband needs $100.000 to pay for his health treatment and his nephew offered you many part-time jobs at his university. How far can you go to keep your husband's healthy?

[From [url=https://maledollstudio.itch.io/nephews-husband]Itch.io[/url]]

你的丈夫急需10万美元支付医疗费用，而他的外甥主动在自己就读的大学里为你介绍了好几份兼职差事。为了让丈夫恢复健康，你究竟愿意走到哪一步？
